entities.summary: Abraham de Jesús "Abramo" Conyedo Ruano is a Cuban-born freestyle wrestler representing Italy. He represented Italy at the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo, Japan, winning a bronze medal in the men's freestyle 97 kg event. He is also a bronze medalist at the World Wrestling Championships and the European Wrestling Championships.
